title: Jellyfish dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bell / dome of jellyfish -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="30" ry="24" fill="#ff69b4"/>
  <!-- Lighter highlight on bell -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="33" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#ff9ed0"/>
  <!-- Inner glow spot -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="30" rx="12" ry="8" fill="#ffd1e8"/>
  <!-- Bell scallop edge -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="55" r="7" fill="#ff69b4"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="58" r="7" fill="#ff69b4"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="7" fill="#ff69b4"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="58" r="7" fill="#ff69b4"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="55" r="7" fill="#ff69b4"/>
  <!-- Scallop edge highlights -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="54" r="4" fill="#ff9ed0"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="57" r="4" fill="#ff9ed0"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="59" r="4" fill="#ff9ed0"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="57" r="4" fill="#ff9ed0"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="54" r="4" fill="#ff9ed0"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="38" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="38" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="38" r="3" fill="#3a2a6a"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="38" r="3" fill="#3a2a6a"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="36" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="36" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Happy smile -->
  <path d="M44 46 Q50 52 56 46" stroke="#3a2a6a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Blush cheeks -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="45" r="4" fill="#ff9ed0" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="45" r="4" fill="#ff9ed0" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- Tentacles - dancing/swaying -->
  <!-- Left tentacle -->
  <path d="M30 60 Q22 70 28 80 Q34 88 26 95" stroke="#ff69b4" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M30 60 Q22 70 28 80 Q34 88 26 95" stroke="#ffd1e8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Mid-left tentacle -->
  <path d="M40 62 Q32 74 40 84 Q46 90 38 97" stroke="#ff69b4" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M40 62 Q32 74 40 84 Q46 90 38 97" stroke="#ffd1e8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Center tentacle -->
  <path d="M50 63 Q54 76 46 86 Q40 92 50 98" stroke="#ff69b4" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 63 Q54 76 46 86 Q40 92 50 98" stroke="#ffd1e8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Mid-right tentacle -->
  <path d="M60 62 Q68 74 60 84 Q54 90 62 97" stroke="#ff69b4" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 62 Q68 74 60 84 Q54 90 62 97" stroke="#ffd1e8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right tentacle -->
  <path d="M70 60 Q78 70 72 80 Q66 88 74 95" stroke="#ff69b4" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M70 60 Q78 70 72 80 Q66 88 74 95" stroke="#ffd1e8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Little music notes to show dancing -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="22" r="2.5" fill="#a0e8ff"/>
  <path d="M80 22 L80 12 L86 14 L86 18 L82 16 L82 22" fill="#a0e8ff"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="30" r="2" fill="#a0e8ff"/>
  <path d="M22 30 L22 22 L27 23.5 L27 27 L23.5 25.5 L23.5 30" fill="#a0e8ff"/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <path d="M85 42 L86.5 45 L90 45.5 L87 47.5 L88 51 L85 49 L82 51 L83 47.5 L80 45.5 L83.5 45 Z" fill="#fff59d"/>
  <path d="M15 48 L16 50.5 L19 51 L16.5 52.5 L17.5 55 L15 53.5 L12.5 55 L13.5 52.5 L11 51 L14 50.5 Z" fill="#fff59d"/>
</svg>
